rationale: The replication independently reimplemented the paper's k·p effective model (Eqs. 1-10) and reproduced all core analytic predictions to machine precision: pz helical spin texture with correct handedness, px/py orbital spin textures following [sin,cos] form, 2θ orbital-character modulation, and the Ppx polarization including its sign flip across the Dirac point. The only discrepancy is an exact factor-2 prefactor in total in-plane spin magnitude—a documented convention gap from collapsing the atom sum, not a physics disagreement. No hexagonal warping was implemented because the paper contains none (correctly scoped). Ab-initio cross-checks were appropriately excluded for this analytic model replication.
